findings: No initial TV clipping or overlapping controls observed.
Four-word vocabulary fits one row; five/seven-word layouts use two rows.
Supporting labels, sorting group names and parent controls remain small at TV size.
Missing monnaie visual and off-screen renderer contradictions confirmed; see audit.
limitations: Initial states only; no claim of all interaction-state inspection.
Screenshots are not a physical TV distance test.
